lines.rom: om bhumirbhumna dyaurvarina ntariksam mahitva upasthe te devyadite gnimannadamannadyaya dadhe
a yam gauh prsnirakramidasananmataram punah pitaram ca prayantsuvah
trigsaddhama vi rajati vakpatangaya sisriye pratyasya vaha dyubhih
yat tva kruddhah parovapa manyuna yadavartya sukalpamagne tat tava punastvoddipayamasi
yat te manyuparoptasya prthivimanu dadhvase aditya visve taddeva vasavasca samabharann
mano jyotirjusatamajyam vicchinnam yajnag samimam dadhatu brhaspatistanutamimam no visve deva iha madayantam
